story: Everyone says AI will change everything.
For most companies, what you actually have is a pile of tools that do not talk to each other, and people still doing the work by hand.
Decks and audits accumulate. The layer that turns those ideas into working software is often missing.
AI alone is a promise. Your business needs systems.
Value appears when technology sits inside the way you already operate, not beside it.

privacy.title: Transparency and trust at the core of our operations.
privacy.metaDescription: How MAWT collects, uses and protects personal data, in line with the revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nLPD) and the GDPR.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
content: The controller responsible for personal data collected through mawt.ch is:
Any question relating to data protection can be sent to the address above.

sections.title: 2. Scope and legal framework
content: This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data when you visit our website, contact us, or engage our services.

We process personal data in accordance with the **revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nLPD)** and, where applicable, in particular for individuals located in the European Economic Area, the **General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)**.

sections.title: 3. Principles
content: We collect only the data necessary for the purposes set out below. We never sell your personal data, and we disclose it to third parties only as described in this policy or where required by law.

sections.title: 4. Data we collect and why
content: Each time you visit the site, our hosting provider automatically records:

items: your IP address, where applicable shortened or anonymised;
the date and time of the request;
the pages visited and the volume of data transferred;
your browser type and version, and operating system;

content: **Purpose:** ensuring the technical operation, security and stability of the site, detecting misuse, and producing aggregated statistics.
**Legal basis:** legitimate interest (Art. 31 nLPD / Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
**Retention:** 90 days, unless a security incident requires longer retention.

When you contact us through the site, we process the data you provide: your name, your email address, the service you are interested in, your indicative project timeline, and the content of your message.
**Purpose:** responding to your enquiry, preparing a proposal, and managing the commercial relationship.
**Legal basis:** pre-contractual measures or performance of a contract, and our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries.
**Retention:** for the duration of the commercial relationship and then 10 years under Swiss accounting obligations, or 12 months where no relationship is established.
In the course of delivering our services (IT consulting, web development, automation, artificial intelligence), we process contact and billing data relating to our clients and their staff.
**Purpose:** performance of the contract, invoicing, support, and compliance with legal and accounting obligations.
**Retention:** 10 years from the end of the contractual relationship, in line with Swiss record-keeping requirements.
If you subscribe to our newsletter, we process your email address and, where provided, your name.
**Legal basis:** your consent, which you may withdraw at any time via the unsubscribe link included in every message, or by email.
**Retention:** until you unsubscribe.

content.text: 4.5 Data processed on behalf of clients

content: In the context of client projects (CRM, automation, integrations), MAWT may act as a **processor** within the meaning of the nLPD and the GDPR. Such processing is governed by the contract and data processing agreement concluded with the client concerned, not by this policy.

sections.title: 5. Cookies and audience measurement
content: The site uses cookies that are strictly necessary for it to work, such as session management, preferences and security. These do not require your consent.
Where we measure how the site is used in order to improve it, we do so only with your consent, collected through the cookie banner. Analytics cookies are never set before you accept them.
You can change your preferences at any time through the cookie settings available in the site footer, or configure your browser to refuse cookies.

sections.title: 6. Hosting and third-party providers
content: The website is hosted by **Hostinger**.
We work with carefully selected providers bound by contractual confidentiality and security obligations, in particular for:

items: content management, and storage of contact enquiries and newsletter sign-ups: Sanity;
abuse protection and rate limiting: Upstash;
email delivery for enquiry notifications and newsletters: our email service provider.

sections.title: 7. International transfers
content: Some providers may be located outside Switzerland. Where data is transferred to a country that does not offer an adequate level of protection under the Federal Council list, we implement appropriate safeguards, in particular the **Standard Contractual Clauses** recognised by the FDPIC and the European Commission.

sections.title: 8. Security
content: We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration or disclosure: TLS encryption of communications, access controls, strong authentication, regular backups, and security updates.
No transmission over the internet can, however, be guaranteed to be entirely secure.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
content: Under the nLPD and, where applicable, the GDPR, you have the right to:

items: **access** the personal data we hold about you;
**object** to processing based on legitimate interest;
**withdraw consent** at any time, without retroactive effect;
**data portability**, meaning receiving your data in a common electronic format;
**not be subject to automated individual decisions** producing legal effects.

content: To exercise these rights, write to **info@mawt.ch**. We may ask you to verify your identity to prevent disclosure to a third party. We will respond within 30 days.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the **Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC)**, Feldeggweg 1, 3003 Bern, Switzerland, or with the competent supervisory authority in your EU country of residence.

sections.title: 10. External links and social media
content: Our site may contain links to third-party websites or to our profiles on external platforms such as LinkedIn, X, Instagram and Facebook. We have no control over these sites and accept no responsibility for their data protection practices. We encourage you to review their own privacy policies.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this policy
content: We reserve the right to amend this policy at any time to reflect changes in our services or in the legal framework. The applicable version is the one published on this page at the time of your visit.

cookies.title: Clear transparency regarding tracking and consent.
cookies.metaDescription: Which cookies MAWT uses, how long they last, and how to change your choices at any time. No advertising and no ad trackers.

sections.title: What a cookie is
content: A cookie is a small file placed on your browser by a website. It allows a site to keep a session open or remember a preference from one page to the next.

sections.title: What we use
content: We keep this simple: **no advertising, no ad trackers, no sale of data**.
Required for the site to work: session handling, security, language preference, and remembering your cookie choices. They cannot be disabled and do not require your consent.
Where we measure how the site is used in order to improve it, analytics cookies are set only after you accept them through the cookie banner.
IP addresses are truncated before processing and statistics are used only in aggregate. We do not seek to identify individual visitors.

sections.title: How long cookies last
content: Session cookies disappear when you close your browser. Others are kept for a maximum of **13 months**, after which they expire automatically.

sections.title: Managing your cookies
content: At any time you can:

items: change your choices through the cookie banner on the site;
configure your browser to block or delete cookies, which Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge all offer in their privacy settings;

content: Blocking necessary cookies may prevent parts of the site from working properly.

sections.title: Embedded content
content: Some pages may include elements from third-party services such as video, maps or forms. These services may set their own cookies, governed by their own policies.

sections.title: Questions
content: For full details of how we process data, see our **privacy policy**.

security.title: Security is part of what we do.
security.metaDescription: How MAWT protects its systems and client data: encrypted connections, access control, backups, environment separation and vulnerability reporting.

content: Clients trust us with their systems, their operational data and sometimes their infrastructure, so we apply to our own organisation the principles we recommend to them.

sections.title: Our approach
content: We favour simple, verifiable choices over complex arrangements that are poorly understood: restricted access, logging, and a small number of carefully selected providers.

items: **Encrypted connections**: the entire site and our services are served over HTTPS (TLS).
**Hosting**: our web environments and email are hosted with Hostinger.
**Access control**: two-factor authentication on sensitive accounts, least-privilege principle, periodic access reviews.
**Updates**: regular monitoring of security patches on the systems and dependencies we operate.
**Environment separation**: development, staging and production are kept apart.
**Providers**: we assess suppliers on their location, contractual commitments and security practices.

sections.title: Client data
content: When working on client systems, we access only the data required to carry out the engagement, for its duration. Access is individually assigned and revoked when the engagement ends.
We are happy to sign a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) or a data processing agreement (DPA) where the context calls for one.

sections.title: Reporting a vulnerability
content: If you believe you have found a flaw in one of our sites or services, write to **info@mawt.ch** with enough detail to reproduce the issue.
We ask that you:

items: do not access, modify or delete data that is not yours;
do not degrade the service, through denial of service, mass sending or social engineering;
allow us a reasonable period to fix the issue before publishing anything.

content: We acknowledge reports promptly and keep you informed of progress. We do not run a bug bounty programme, but serious reports are always welcome, and credited.

sections.title: Limits
content: No system is completely secure. The measures described here reflect our practices and constitute neither a guarantee nor a contractual commitment. Commitments applicable to a specific engagement are set out in the contract signed with the client concerned.

sections.title: Good practice on your side
content: Enable two-factor authentication, use unique passwords and a password manager, and verify the sender before responding to an unusual request. We will never ask you for a password by email or by phone.
